title: AI Can Learn Scientific Taste
focus_en: Learns a Scientific Judge from field- and time-matched citation preferences, then uses its rewards to train a Scientific Thinker for follow-up idea generation.
focus_zh: 从领域与时间匹配的引用偏好中训练 Scientific Judge，再用其奖励训练 Scientific Thinker 生成后续研究想法。
boundary_en: Citations operationalize community reception, not scientific value itself; generated ideas are mainly evaluated by LLM judges and are not experimentally validated.
boundary_zh: 引用量是学术共同体反响的代理，不能直接等同于科学价值；生成想法主要由 LLM 评审，尚未经过实验验证。

title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
focus_en: Evaluates iterative experiment design and result interpretation on AI R&D tasks while using a fixed coding agent to separate research decisions from implementation.
focus_zh: 在 AI R&D 任务上评估迭代实验设计与结果解释，并通过固定 coding agent 将研究决策与代码实现区分开。
boundary_en: Taste is operationalized as experimental compute efficiency on assigned problems; open-ended problem selection is not measured, and the tasks are not publicly released.
boundary_zh: 将 taste 操作化为给定问题上的实验算力效率，不评估开放式选题能力，且任务未公开发布。

title: HindSight: Evaluating LLM-Generated Research Ideas via Future Impact
focus_en: Proposes retrospective evaluation by matching generated ideas to later publications and weighting matches using citations and venue acceptance.
focus_zh: 提出回顾式评价：将生成想法与后续论文匹配，并用引用量和发表 venue 对匹配结果加权。
boundary_en: Publication matching is an impact proxy that can undervalue unexplored ideas; the stated model knowledge cutoff is later than the retrieval cutoff, so temporal leakage is not excluded.
boundary_zh: 论文匹配只是影响力代理，可能低估尚未被探索的想法；文中模型知识截止时间晚于检索截止时间，因此不能排除时间泄漏。

title: Style Wins, Substance Loses: A Diagnosis of LLM-as-Judge in Idea Generation
focus_en: Uses controlled changes to idea presentation and substance to test whether LLM judges reward scientific content or persuasive writing style.
focus_zh: 通过受控改变想法的表达风格与实质内容，检验 LLM judge 奖励的是科学内容还是有说服力的写作风格。
boundary_en: Measures evaluator robustness and ranking bias under constructed perturbations; it does not establish the long-term scientific value of the evaluated ideas.
boundary_zh: 测量构造扰动下评审器的稳健性与排序偏差，不直接验证被评想法的长期科学价值。

title: Is This Idea Novel? An Automated Benchmark for Judgment of Research Ideas
focus_en: Benchmarks research-idea novelty scores and their justifications against expert-derived judgments, making novelty assessment a separately measurable research capability.
focus_zh: 用专家判断评估研究想法的新颖性评分及其理由，将 novelty assessment 作为可单独测量的科研能力。
boundary_en: Agreement with novelty judgments is distinct from generating new questions, predicting feasibility, or demonstrating scientific importance; plausible rationales need not imply correct judgments.
boundary_zh: 与新颖性判断一致，不等于能提出新问题、预测可行性或证明科学重要性；理由听起来合理也不代表判断正确。

title: The Ideation-Execution Gap: Execution Outcomes of LLM-Generated versus Human Research Ideas
focus_en: Has researchers execute human- and LLM-generated ideas and compares expert assessments before and after execution, connecting proposal quality to realized research outcomes.
focus_zh: 让研究者执行人类与 LLM 提出的想法，对比执行前后的专家评价，将提案质量与实际研究结果联系起来。
boundary_en: Execution is human-led and outcomes are assessed within an NLP research study; this is evidence about idea evaluation, not a demonstration of autonomous research execution.
boundary_zh: 执行由人类主导，结果在 NLP 研究场景中评估；它提供想法评价的证据，并非自主科研执行能力的展示。

title: Can LLMs Generate Novel Research Ideas? A Large-Scale Human Study with 100+ NLP Researchers
focus_en: Compares LLM-generated research proposals with expert-written ideas through blinded expert review and examines generation diversity and self-evaluation failures.
focus_zh: 通过专家盲审比较 LLM 与专家提出的研究方案，并分析生成多样性和自我评价的失败模式。
boundary_en: The main evidence concerns perceived novelty and feasibility of NLP proposals before execution; expert preference is not proof of successful discoveries or downstream scientific value.
boundary_zh: 主要证据是执行前对 NLP 提案新颖性与可行性的评价；专家偏好不能证明已经实现科学发现或下游科学价值。

title: SciMON: Scientific Inspiration Machines Optimized for Novelty
focus_en: Generates natural-language research directions from supplied backgrounds by retrieving scientific inspirations and iteratively revising ideas against related work.
focus_zh: 从给定研究背景出发检索科学启发，并通过与相关工作比较、迭代修改，生成自然语言研究方向。
boundary_en: Novelty-oriented proposal generation is conditioned on supplied contexts; novelty relative to retrieved literature does not establish experimental validity or research importance.
boundary_zh: 以新颖性为目标的提案生成依赖给定背景；相对检索文献的新颖性不能证明实验有效性或研究重要性。

title: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with Large Language Models
focus_en: Uses a seed paper, academic graph, and entity knowledge store to formulate problems, methods, and experiment plans refined by reviewing agents.
focus_zh: 利用种子论文、学术关系图与实体知识库提出问题、方法和实验计划，并通过 reviewing agents 迭代完善。
boundary_en: Evidence is based on human and model evaluations of generated proposals; producing an experiment design is not the same as executing and validating it.
boundary_zh: 证据来自对生成提案的人类与模型评价；生成实验设计不等于已执行并验证该实验。

title: Scideator: Human-LLM Compound System for Scientific Ideation through Facet Recombination and Novelty Evaluation
focus_en: Supports human-AI ideation by recombining purpose, mechanism, and evaluation facets of papers, with literature-grounded checks of proposed ideas' novelty.
focus_zh: 通过重组论文的问题目的、方法机制和评价方式支持人机共同构思，并依据文献检查想法的新颖性。
boundary_en: A mixed-initiative system evaluated through user studies and novelty-checker ablations; creativity support and novelty judgments do not establish autonomous discoveries or realized impact.
boundary_zh: 这是经用户研究与新颖性检查器消融评估的人机协作系统；创造力支持和新颖性判断不能证明自主发现或实际影响。

title: SciPIP: An LLM-based Scientific Paper Idea Proposer
focus_en: Combines semantic, keyword, and citation-aware literature retrieval with brainstorming and retrieval-based generation to propose ideas for supplied research backgrounds.
focus_zh: 结合语义、关键词和引用关系检索，以及 brainstorming 与检索生成两条路径，为给定研究背景提出想法。
boundary_en: Evaluation uses expert ratings of NLP and computer-vision proposals; perceived feasibility and helpfulness are not evidence that the proposals were successfully executed.
boundary_zh: 评价采用专家对 NLP 和计算机视觉提案的评分；被认为可行或有帮助，不代表提案已经成功执行。

title: Chain of Ideas: Revolutionizing Research Via Novel Idea Development with LLM Agents
focus_en: Organizes literature into chains of research developments to generate ideas and experiment designs, and introduces Idea Arena for comparative proposal evaluation.
focus_zh: 将文献组织成研究发展链，以生成想法和实验设计，并提出 Idea Arena 对提案进行比较评价。
boundary_en: Comparative proposal ratings measure judged idea quality; they do not demonstrate executed discoveries, and organizing past literature is not itself learning from new experiments.
boundary_zh: 提案比较评分衡量的是被评判的想法质量，不能证明已经执行的科学发现；组织既有文献本身也不等于从新实验中学习。
